title: Does Accuracy Equal Evidence? Reasoning Faithfulness under KV Cache Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.01631v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: KV cache compression is commonly evaluated by final-answer accuracy, implicitly assuming that preserving the answer also preserves the reasoning that supports it. We test this assumption for large reasoning models and show that it can fail: under compression, correct answers and the validity of their visible supporting rationales can be preserved at different rates. We study this failure with a controlled fixed-trace replay protocol, which holds reasoning content fixed and isolates whether compression preserves usable information from an already available trace. We evaluate ten token-eviction KV compression methods and one quantization method on three models across mathematical reasoning, scientific QA, clinical calculation, and long-context retrieval. translated_title: 准确率等同于证据吗？KV缓存压缩下的推理忠实性
translated_abstract: KV缓存压缩通常通过最终答案准确率来评估，这隐含地假设了保住答案就等于保住了支持该答案的推理过程。我们针对大型推理模型检验了这一假设，并证明它可能失效：在压缩条件下，正确答案与其可见的支持性推理依据的有效性可能以不同的速率被保留。我们采用一种受控的固定轨迹回放协议来研究这一失效现象，该协议保持推理内容固定不变，从而隔离出压缩是否能够从一条已有的推理轨迹中保留可用信息。我们在三个模型上评估了十种token逐出式KV压缩方法和一种量化方法，涵盖数学推理、科学问答、临床计算和长上下文检索等任务，并测量了最终准确率、答案与推理链的一致性以及扰动忠实性。实验表明，在各类任务中，token逐出方法可以在保持具有竞争力的最终答案准确率的同时，显著损害推理依据的忠实性。
tldr: 本文揭示了KV缓存压缩评估中“准确率等同于证据”这一隐含假设的缺陷——即使最终答案准确率保持不变，压缩仍可能显著破坏支持答案的推理过程的忠实性，并提出固定轨迹回放协议来分离测量这一现象。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes the flaw in the implicit "accuracy equals evidence" assumption in KV cache compression evaluation—compression can substantially undermine the faithfulness of supporting rationales even when final-answer accuracy is preserved, and introduces a fixed-trace replay protocol to isolate and measure this divergence.
